BL-859 — Nothing checks the boot-prefix cap when an amendment is authored: the specifier commits article growth straight to main and an unrelated parcel discovers the over-cap RED weeks later
What it solves: E2E QA procedure: with the real tree at or under budget, run the gate and
confirm exit 0 and a reported size equal to the "stable-prefix chars:"
value `bb swarmforge/scripts/test/prompt_engine_test_runner.bb` prints —
the two numbers must match exactly, which is the parity invariant; then
append a …
Approval context: Sign-off wanted on making the budget a HARD failure rather than a warning. A warning reproduces today's situation (the bb runner already reports the number and is simply not run at authoring time). A hard failure means that once the prefix reaches the budget, the specifier cannot add a rule without…
BL-859 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-859" (or "reject BL-859 <reason>") to act.
